name: GGV AI & DS — Request Intake Queue

parameters.content:
SETUP BEFORE ACTIVATION
1) Configure Header Auth on the webhook with request header `x-ggv-automation-secret`; set the same secret as `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in Vercel.
2) The Supabase request node uses an n8n HTTP Header Auth credential named `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_AUTHORIZATION_HEADER`; create it with header name `Authorization` and value `Bearer <Manushyaa service-role key>`. The publishable apikey is already set in this export. Never commit the service-role key.
3) Apply the branch hub migrations first. The request queue is RLS-protected; public/anonymous users cannot read or write it directly.
4) This workflow only creates a `pending_review` request. It does not publish an item or send email. An authorized staff member must review it in the dashboard.
5) Add rate limiting/abuse controls to the Vercel endpoint before public launch.
